messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The webhook dispatcher's deploy window is on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2026-03-10 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-10-2]
- As of 2026-02-23, the scheduler's deploy window remains weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2026-02-23 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-02-23]
- Dashboards and alerts for the catalog service are being repointed as of 2025-06-16. [valid 2025-06-16 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-16-catalog]
- Farah takes the first on-call rotation for Team Dune. [valid 2025-01-16 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-16]
- The indexer's OpenSearch 2.11 pin lifts when the full reindex completes. [valid 2025-08-27 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-08-27]
- The catalog service depends on the resizer for thumbnails. [valid 2025-04-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-04-15]
- Priya takes the first Atlas pager shift. [valid 2025-01-14 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-14]
- As of 2026-03-16, the catalog service deploys on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2026-03-16 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-16]
    earlier: The catalog service ships only on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-03-24 to 2026-03-16; recorded by standup/dune/2025-03-24]
- The indexer depends on the catalog service for product documents. [valid 2025-02-28 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-02-28]
- On 2025-05-08, Team Boreal observed that the catalog service's memory use grew steadily for a week following the cache change, and flagged it since the catalog service is not Team Boreal's service. [valid 2025-05-08 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-05-08]
- INC-2026-009 was an incident in which the scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-03. [valid 2026-05-08 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- INC-2026-003 was an incident in which the webhooks service delivered some events twice on 2026-01-17. [valid 2026-01-22 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- Lena takes the first Boreal on-call shift of the year. [valid 2025-01-13 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-13]
- As of 2025-03-20, the pager for the catalog service rings Team Dune instead of Team Cinder. [valid 2025-03-20 to now; recorded by handover/2025-03-20-catalog]
- Yuki takes the first Team Cinder on-call shift of the year. [valid 2025-01-14 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-14]
- The catalog service's joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time. [valid 2025-04-04 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-04-04]
- As of 2026-05-25, Team Atlas has switched to a no-deploy Friday. [decision; valid 2026-05-25 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-25-2]
- Dashboards and alerts for the resizer are being repointed as of 2025-04-29. [valid 2025-04-29 to now; recorded by handover/2025-04-29-image-resizer]
- As of 2025-11-20, dashboards and alerts for the event bus are being repointed. [valid 2025-11-20 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-20-event-bus]
- On 2026-03-31, the Ember team observed that the feature-flags service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy, and flagged it since the feature-flags service is not the Ember team's service. [valid 2026-03-31 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-31]

Question: Which note first recorded the deploy window for the catalog, and when?

There are two entries about catalog deploy windows:
- "As of 2026-03-16, the catalog service deploys on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC." [constraint; valid 2026-03-16 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-16], with earlier: "The catalog service ships only on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC." [constraint; valid 2025-03-24 to 2026-03-16; recorded by standup/dune/2025-03-24]

The first record would be the earlier one: standup/dune/2025-03-24, recorded 2025-03-24.

So the answer: standup/dune/2025-03-24, on 2025-03-24.
